DLF08_A.copy: Hook: Renee's handwritten three-column list on the kitchen counter, with Jake's cloudy retainer beside it.
DLF08_A.prompt: Phone photo taken from above at a slight angle on a kitchen counter at night under a ceiling light. A sheet of lined notebook paper with handwriting in blue ballpoint, divided into three columns by hand-drawn lines, short scribbled notes in each column, some words underlined and some crossed out, a pen lying across it. Next to the paper, an open small plastic retainer case holding one clear plastic retainer shaped like a full upper dental arch, visibly cloudy and milky with a white chalky crust along the edges. Reading glasses, a mug and a phone face down at the edges of the frame. IMPORTANT: the handwriting is messy and not legible, no readable words; the retainer is anatomically realistic. No logos.

DLF08_B.copy: The failed fix: the baking-soda scrub that scratched the retainer cloudy.
DLF08_B.prompt: Phone photo with flash taken in a teenage boy's cluttered bathroom at night. On the edge of the white sink: an open cardboard box of baking soda with a plain orange box and no readable label, a small pile of spilled white powder, a worn-out toothbrush with splayed bristles, and a clear plastic retainer shaped like a full upper dental arch that is cloudy, scratched and milky with dried white flaky residue. Wet sink, a deodorant stick and a hair gel tub in the background. IMPORTANT: no brand names, logos or readable text on any box or product; the retainer is anatomically realistic.

DLF08_C.copy: The smell in the car: Jake's backpack in the back seat with the retainer case clipped to the strap, the window cracked.
DLF08_C.prompt: Phone photo taken from the driver's seat, turned around toward the back seat of a family SUV on an October evening after school. A black school backpack sits on the seat with a small plastic retainer case clipped to the shoulder strap with a carabiner. A rolled-up sports hoodie and a water bottle next to it. The rear passenger window is cracked open a few inches; outside, dusk and bare-ish trees with orange leaves. Dome light on, slightly grainy. IMPORTANT: no people's faces, no logos on the backpack, case or car, no readable text.

DLF08_D.copy: The payoff routine: the Pod on Jake's bathroom counter, a 15-year-old's one-button habit.
DLF08_D.prompt: Phone photo taken from standing height in a teenage boy's bathroom on a November morning. On the counter sits the white ribbed dome ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo, closed, next to an open small retainer case, a phone charging cable, a stick of deodorant, a hair product tub, and a toothbrush on the edge of the sink. A boy's hand in a grey hoodie sleeve is pressing the top of the cleaner. Ordinary bathroom light, a towel thrown over the shower rod in the background. IMPORTANT: the cleaner looks exactly like the reference photo, unchanged, no screens or extra buttons; no logos or readable text on the other products.
